Meanwhile, content around #PerfumeMists is focused on reviews and recommendations of lightweight, refreshing fragrance formats. #TattooLipLiner content is also on the rise, featuring ink-like liners, peel-off stains, and semi-permanent lip treatments for long-lasting lip definition. #GlowyMakeupRoutine points to interest in luminous, radiant makeup looks and routines, while #FeatheredHair highlights interest in the ’70s voluminous, heavily layered hair look. Together, these trends highlight how beauty content is increasingly shaped by product discovery, makeup routines and nostalgic aesthetics.

There’s growing interest in fragrance trends that combine personalization, identity, and convenience. Alcohol-free fragrances, for example, reflect demand for alternative formulations to traditional perfumes, while custom perfumes point to interest in personalized scents tailored to individual preferences. The rise of masculine fragrances suggests that scent is increasingly functioning as an identity marker for male and female consumers alike, while gothic perfume reflects demand for darker and more mysterious aromatic profiles that evoke the romantic and atmospheric elements of the goth aesthetic. Finally, travel fragrances, the portable and convenient scent formats designed to make fragrance easier to pack and use on the go, are also trending.

This month, there’s particular interest in fragrance brands offering distinctive approaches to scent. Lore’s emotive, transportive fragrances translate specific moods and places into immersive scent experiences, while MCM Fragrance and Miu Miu highlight growing interest in luxury scents that extend recognizable fashion identities into fragrance, with searches for the latter mainly associated with Miutine and its youthful fragrance identity. Ranger Station stands out for its bold, high-concentration, nature-inspired scents, while Maison d’Etto offers perfumes rooted in equestrian influence, contemporary art and architecture. These brands highlight growing consumer interest in fragrance that goes beyond scent itself, offering distinctive stories, identities and sensory experiences.

Industry observers note that as we enter October season, #SpookyNailArt is trending on TikTok, reflecting interest in Halloween-inspired nail designs based on playful motifs. Meanwhile, growing interest in the #MakeupColorTheory reinforces the rise of consumers learning about the hues that enhance their features. #ConcertHair highlights demand for hairstyles that are durable, creative and highly accessorized, specifically designed to last throughout a concert, while the #RomanticUpdo reflects interest in soft, feminine hairstyles and intentionally undone styles. #CologneHaul shows interest in discovering and showcasing fragrance purchases and collections.

According to recent reports, when it comes to nails, there’s a growing interest in trends that combine precision, personalization, and visually distinct finishes. The Italian manicure, which creates the appearance of longer slender nails, reflects demand for more precise techniques, while nail art pens and letters on nails point to interest in customized designs and intricate details. The rise of glass nail polish highlights a preference for glossy, translucent finishes, and vibrant nails reflect demand for bold, eye-catching colors.

Among this month’s trending nail brands, there’s a clear preference for distinct approaches to at-home manicures. Reusable, press-on nail line Never Have I Ever incorporates licensed artwork from independent artists and cultural icons into nail designs, while Double Rhythm reinforces interest in accessible, soak-off gel polishes and nail art supplies for DIY and salon-style looks. IPolish stands out for its digital color-changing press-on nails, allowing owners to switch between hundreds of shades using a smartphone and activation wand. Heyhae offers sun-cured gel nail strips that harden naturally in sunlight without requiring a traditional UV or LED lamp, while Sparkle & Co. specializes in DIY dip powders with unique glitters, foils, flakes, glow-in-the-dark, and color-changing effects.

According to recent reports, tikTok is seeing an influx of content featuring #BumperBangs, reflecting interest in vintage 1940s and ’50s fringe styles consisting of a bold, rounded shape. Meanwhile, the rise of #CurlyHairBride highlights demand for bridal hair inspiration that embraces natural curls and textured styles. #WigsOnTikTok shows the growing role of TikTok in discovering, styling, and showcasing wigs. #UltaFragrance and #SephoraBeautyAdvisor highlight interest in beauty advisors sharing recommendations, product expertise and customer interactions at retailers Ulta and Sephora. Together, these hashtags highlight interest in vintage looks, occasion-specific styling, and behind-the-scenes beauty retail experiences.

There’s a growing interest in makeup products that combine ease of use, enhanced appearance, and convenient beauty benefits, according to monthly search data. Growth in creamy lip liners points to demand for smooth, easy-to-apply products that shape and define the lips, while lip volumizers help create the appearance of fuller, smoother lips without invasive treatments. Rose gold eyeshadow is also trending, driven by demand for warm, luminous shades. Gripping primer, which is a gel-based product with a tacky finish to hold your makeup in place, reflects interest in creating durable makeup looks that last throughout the day. The rise of SPF face powder reveals interest in facial sun protection beyond conventional sunscreens, with multifunctional products that both protect and control shine.

Across makeup brands, those offering distinctive products spanning various price points are performing particularly well. Hung Vanngo Beauty reflects demand for makeup artist expertise, while Burberry Beauty signals continued interest in luxury cosmetics from established fashion houses. C-beauty brand Cheeryep and Sleek Makeup highlight demand for vibrant, high-pigment makeup and innovative finishes. Maven Beauty, Fashion Nova’s makeup brand, suggests growing demand for affordable beauty options.

On TikTok, #UVHairExtensions are gaining traction, reflecting interest in innovative UV and LED hair extension techniques offering fast application, while #BrownRedHair highlights demand for rich, warm hair color combinations of brown, red, copper, and mahogany tones. Manicurist content featuring #PracticeNails reveals past designs and their training progress, while #CottagecoreNails spotlights whimsical, nature-inspired manicures influenced by cottagecore aesthetics. The rise of #BridesmaidsMakeup reflects growing demand for beauty inspiration tailored to bridesmaids and wedding looks.

In skincare, monthly interest in products and treatments that combine targeted skin health benefits with gentle, barrier-supporting ingredients and advanced technologies is rising. Silicone-free sunscreen and its lightweight, ingredient-conscious sun protection is trending, while the retinol sandwich method, where retinol is layered between moisturizer to reduce the risk of irritation, is gaining traction among those looking to safely introduce retinol into their routines. There is continued demand for hyaluronic acid face lotions offering convenient, hydrating properties that support moisture retention and skin plumpness, while ceramide toners are designed to strengthen and maintain the skin barrier. Interest in high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) treatments highlights demand for advanced, non-invasive aesthetic treatments focused on skin tightening and rejuvenation.

For brands, those offering science-backed and targeted skincare solutions are trending. Elm Biosciences, which develops clinical skincare focused on healthy aging and cellular-level care, is gaining traction, while Magic Molecule offers hypochlorous acid solutions that cleanse, reduce inflammation and support skin healing. The rise of TropicSport signals demand for high-performance sun protection during active lifestyles. NewGel+ reflects interest in specialized scarcare and skin repair. The Body Shop, particularly its Drops of Youth line, highlights demand for products targeting early signs of aging while supporting skin resilience against daily environmental stressors.

On TikTok, #SheinMakeupHaul is trending, reflective of the growing interest in discovering and sharing affordable makeup products through beauty hauls. #BestHairOils shows how more consumers are comparing different hair oils and seeking product recommendations. #BakedBlush features content spotlighting new blush launches and shades comparisons through product swatches and reviews. #TinselBraids and #CakeNails highlight playful approaches to self-expression through decorative hairstyles and creative nail designs, with consumers exploring visually distinctive looks.

Recent findings suggest that this month’s search data highlights growing interest in haircare products that combine targeted follicle growth with plant-based ingredients. Popular hair serums range from including specific active ingredients, with searches for redensyl and peptide serums that help reduce shedding by supporting follicle health and improving fullness, to concern-specific searches such as hair thinning serum. Rice water hairspray highlights demand for convenient, multifunctional products that can strengthen strands, add shine and reduce frizz, while plant-based shampoos reflect growing interest in products made primarily with vegan and botanical ingredients.

Sources indicate that when it comes to haircare brands, those offering performance-driven, science-backed and premium solutions, in particular, are trending. Labo-H reflects demand for Korean scalpcare and hair loss prevention, while UltraSwim highlights interest in cleansing products designed to remove chlorine, chemical odors, and mineral buildup from hair. Bare Anatomy signals demand for science-backed haircare, addressing specific concerns such as shedding, dandruff, frizz, and damage, while Bvlgari Beauty reflects interest in luxury products combining cleansing and scalpcare with the brand’s signature scents. Meanwhile, Iso Beauty highlights growing interest in solutions that deliver salon-quality results at home.

Over on TikTok, #BabyShowerMakeup reflects interest in soft glam makeup looks tailored specifically for mothers and guests attending baby showers, while #MarchMakeup highlights makeup looks based on the birthday month. #QuickCurls highlights demand for fast and easy hairstyling techniques for curly hair, while #LakeHair reflects interest in solutions to avoid or untangle the messy, textured, and sometimes dry or mineral-coated hair associated with freshwater swimming. #AntioxidantSerum shows dermatologist content discussing skincare products centered around antioxidant benefits and protection from environmental stressors.

Across wellness, monthly search data highlights growing interest in products that combine targeted benefits, convenience, and ease of use. Dopamine patches, for example, reflect demand for wearable solutions associated with mood and focus support, while acupressure wristbands reveal interest in convenient solutions for managing and preventing nausea, particularly concerning travel and motion sickness. Screenless fitness trackers demonstrate growing demand for minimalist wearable technology that passively monitors health and activity data without the distraction of a screen. Men’s fertility supplements signal interest in targeted nutritional support for male reproductive health, while liquid zinc supplements highlight demand for convenient ways to prevent or address zinc deficiency and support immune health.

For brands, there’s growing interest in those offering targeted, convenient, and science-backed wellness solutions. Pure Genius Protein reflects demand for portable, easy-to-consume protein products, while Artemis Tea highlights interest in organic herbal teas and wellness blends rooted in traditional herbalism. Nancy’s Probiotic signals demand for organic cultured foods and probiotic-focused nutrition, while EFX Sports reflects interest in performance supplements such as Kre-Alkalyn creatine, designed to support strength and recovery. The rise of Sparkle Wellness relates to continued interest in collagen supplements targeting skin, hair, nails, and overall vitality.

Over on TikTok, the growing traction for #BridalUpdoStyle reflects interest in polished, occasion-ready hairstyles for weddings and special events. #FauxBrows and #HowToSelfTan highlight different approaches to enhancing everyday beauty, from creating realistic, hair-like brow strokes to achieving an even, natural-looking tan at home. #MakeupPR reflects the influencer culture around receiving and unboxing gifted beauty products, as well as creators sharing their experiences with brands. #MakeupOver35 highlights growing interest in makeup techniques and product recommendations tailored to women over the age of 35.

In the bodycare space, current search trends highlight growing interest in products that combine targeted benefits and convenience with sensory appeal. Alpha hydroxy (AHA) body lotions and hand exfoliators reflect demand for exfoliating and smoothing products that help remove dead skin cells, dirt, and dry patches. Grape soap highlights playful, fruit-inspired formats that combine functionality with novelty and aesthetics. Epsom salt lotions reflect interest in convenient options for muscle relief and recovery, while kojic acid lotions signal demand for targeted brightening and uneven skin tone care.

According to recent reports, as for bodycare brands, those offering targeted, skin-friendly solutions are gaining traction. QV Skincare reflects demand for sensitive skin and barrier-supportive care, while Naked Bee highlights interest in affordable, natural bodycare options incorporating ingredients such as honey, beeswax, and oatmeal. Derman points to demand for targeted antifungal treatments, and Curology reflects growing interest in dermatologist-designed solutions for body breakouts and rough texture. Meanwhile, Luna Daily highlights demand for pH-balanced, microbiome-friendly care for both the body and intimate areas. These brands reveal how the category is evolving through specialist treatments based on body area and skin concern, spanning natural-based products to dermatologist-designed solutions.

Over on TikTok, #VampNails reflect interest in bold, dramatic nail looks inspired by dark and vampy aesthetics. #RootRetouch and #GrayGrowOut highlight different approaches to managing hair color, from concealing visible roots to embracing the transition to natural gray. #HairVolumeHacks signals demand for accessible styling techniques that create fuller, more voluminous hair. #MakeupTrial reflects interest in testing and refining makeup looks ahead of weddings and special events.

According to recent reports, this month’s search data highlights a shift toward more occasion-driven and emotionally evocative fragrance choices. The rise of wedding fragrances reflects growing interest in scents associated with meaningful celebrations and special occasions. Sport fragrances signal demand for fresh, energetic scents suited to active lifestyles and everyday wear, while sweet fragrances highlight continued preference for gourmand and indulgent scent profiles, with birthday cake perfume, for example, also offering a familiar scent evocative of childhood memories. Electric perfume, meanwhile, with searches mainly associated with the iconic Revlon fragrance from the 80s, Electric Youth, reflects the enduring appeal of discontinued scents that offer a new form of nostalgia.

Sources indicate that when it comes to brands, DefineMe Creative Studio highlights growing interest in fragrance rooted in pop culture, with collaborations such as Barbie connecting scent with recognizable characters and cultural identities. Lore reflects demand for emotive, transportive fragrances that translate specific moods and places into scent experiences. Miu Miu and MCM Fragrance highlight growing interest in luxury scents that extend a recognizable fashion identity into the perfume space, with Miu Miu searches mainly associated with the more youthful and feminine Miutine scent. The rise of Kopari, specifically its fragrance mists, reflects demand for lighter fragrance formats suited to everyday use.

According to recent reports, on TikTok, #CreamEyeshadowSticks are trending, as demand rises for convenient, easy-to-apply makeup formats that allow consumers to create smooth, buildable eye looks with minimal effort. #ChunkyHighlights and #NailFoils reflect growing interest in creative beauty techniques that add dimension and visual impact to hair and nails. #UltaHairSalon reflects consumers’ and salon workers’ experiences with hair services in retail stores, highlighting a convenient way to access professional salon expertise. The continued interest in #DrySkinSolutions signals demand for targeted skincare solutions focused on relieving dryness and supporting skin hydration.

In a recent development, there’s been a rise in search data for nail art pens, reflecting growing interest in personalized nail creativity that’s nostalgic and enables consumers to experiment with intricate and customized designs. Liquid tape reflects demand for manicure tools that simplify application while improving precision and creating cleaner, more professional-looking results. Glitter nail polish is another Y2K trend regaining momentum, with continued interest in bold, statement-making finishes that add a dose of playfulness to nail looks. The sustained demand for glass nail polish underscores the role of high-gloss translucent finishes as a more classic aesthetic. Meanwhile, celestial nails signal increasing enthusiasm for imaginative and artistic nail designs inspired by cosmic themes and metallic accents.

Industry observers note that nars, which phased out its nail polish line, is trending in search data, reflecting the enduring appeal of discontinued beauty products when consumers maintain connections with iconic shades and search for color dupes still available on the market. Tonic Polish and Pure Ice, meanwhile, highlight growing interest in expressive nail finishes, such as multichromes, magnetics and holographics, as well as accessible trend-driven shades, glitters and metallics that keep manicures more unique. Beyond polish, Burt’s Bees highlights growing demand for nourishing nailcare solutions, such as cuticle creams that provide hydration while supporting dry and brittle nails. Diamond Cosmetics signals continued interest in accessible nail products that offer variety and affordability.

In a recent development, on TikTok, #BrighteningEyeMasks reflect demand for targeted skincare solutions, with consumers using under-eye patches to depuff, hydrate, and reduce the appearance of dark circles. Content featuring #MakeupDisaster and #BadNailsCheck highlights the interest from consumers in beauty mishaps, from makeup products that fail to deliver expected results to manicure disasters and negative salon experiences. #SkincareRitual reflects interest in consistent, personalized skincare routines focused on daily maintenance. #NailTechDayInMyLife reflects interest in behind-the-scenes nail content, with consumers engaging with nail technicians’ routines, creative processes, and the realities of running a nail business. Together, these trends reflect growing consumer interest in authentic beauty experiences and personal routines.

Sources indicate that in the makeup space, monthly data highlights growing demand for innovative, personalized, and tech-driven cosmetics. Lipstick printers, associated primarily with YSL Beauty, reflect rising interest in tech-enabled beauty personalization, allowing consumers to create customized lip shades on-demand. Aloe lipstick offers hydrating, soothing properties with pH-reactive formulas that adapt to each wearer’s lips. Soft matte lipstick reflects interest in formulas that deliver a velvety, blurred matte finish without the dryness of traditional matte lipsticks, while terracotta lipstick highlights the popularity of warm, earthy shades that offer a transeasonal beauty look. Meanwhile, ginger mascara signals growing interest in softer, natural-looking eye makeup, with this shade offering a light brown to reddish tint that subtly enhances lashes.

According to recent reports, prestige Cosmetics is among this month’s trending makeup brands, reflecting continued demand for accessible, high-pigment products in a broad range of colors. Hung Vanngo Beauty signals sustained interest in makeup artist-founded brands that deliver professional-quality products based on their expertise. Details by Tati signals demand for creator-led beauty brands centered on luxury makeup tools and elevated application. Black Up is a brand tailored to those looking for inclusive makeup options, offering complexion products specifically developed to enhance deeper skin tones. The enduring appeal of Burberry Beauty, meanwhile, reinforces demand for combining premium formulations with sophisticated, fashion-inspired aesthetics.

In a recent development, over on TikTok, #FrizzyHairHacks and #GrayHairCare reflect growing demand for targeted hair solutions, as more consumers seek practical techniques and specialized products to manage frizz, improve smoothness, and maintain the health and vibrancy of gray and silver hair. #GoldenHourMakeup highlights demand for warm, radiant beauty looks, from golden-toned eye makeup to sun-kissed complexions with natural luminosity. The rise of the #BlondeRoots hashtag reflects continued interest in blonde hair trends that embrace visible roots, like ghost roots. #FullFaceOfDollarTreeMakeup underscores engagement in affordable beauty experimentation, with consumers creating full-face looks using accessible products.

In a recent development, in the skincare space, there’s growing demand for targeted, science-led solutions. Pore mousse reflects interest in innovative K-beauty cleansing formats that deeply purify and refine the appearance of pores, while silicone scar sticks demonstrate demand for convenient scar care that supports scar recovery and improves the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Liquid pimple patches are still rising as the next-generation blemish treatment to combine targeted ingredient delivery with an invisible, flexible finish for everyday wear. Peptide eyelash serum reflects rising interest in peptide-powered formulas that strengthen lashes and promote a fuller, healthier appearance. Meanwhile, increased searches regarding retinoid dermatitis signals the heightened awareness of managing irritation associated with active skincare ingredients.

When it comes to skincare brands, Elm Biosciences underscores growing interest in science-backed, clinically developed products, with a lab-to-patient approach focused on supporting long-term skin health and healthy aging. Caire Beauty reflects demand for hormone-aware skincare for women aged 40 to 65-plus, offering science-driven formulas designed to address the visible effects of perimenopause and menopause through advanced hydration and skin-rebuilding technologies.

Industry observers note that love From Yours highlights the rise of AI-powered personalized skincare, using skin analysis and lifestyle data to create customized routines tailored to individual needs. Radical Skincare represents continued interest in clinical-strength anti-aging solutions that deliver restorative results while remaining suitable for sensitive and blemish-prone skin. Scarlett Whitening, an Indonesian brand, signals growing demand for accessible, ingredient-focused skincare that combines brightening, hydrating, and acne-targeting actives.

According to recent reports, on TikTok, #GlutenFreeMakeup reflects growing interest in inclusive beauty products that cater to ingredient-conscious consumers and specific lifestyle preferences. #FrenchTwistHairstyle and #ColorMelting reflect growing interest in elevated yet wearable hair looks, with consumers embracing timeless styling techniques alongside dimensional, natural-looking hair color trends. #CreamyEyeliner highlights demand for versatile eye makeup products that offer smooth application, rich pigmentation, and effortless wear. #MorningMakeupRoutine points to consumers seeking efficient, everyday beauty rituals and product recommendations that simplify their routines. Together, these trends reflect growing demand for beauty solutions that balance self-expression, convenience, and performance.

In the haircare space, there is growing interest in haircare solutions that combine convenience and science-backed ingredients alongside targeted treatments to support hair and scalp health. Convenience is a significant factor, with waterless dry shampoo and 6-in-1 shampoo signaling the desire for multifunctional products that simplify hair care routines.

Caffeine hair serum highlights increasing interest in scalp-focused formulations designed to help strengthen hair, reduce shedding, and promote the appearance of fuller, healthier-looking hair. Exosome hair therapy underscores the growing popularity of advanced, science-driven hair restoration technologies, with consumers exploring treatments aimed at supporting scalp health, hair regeneration, and overall hair vitality. Finally, overnight hair serum reflects rising demand for treatments that work while users sleep, delivering deep hydration, nourishment, and repair to improve hair strength and smoothness by morning.

According to recent reports, these trends can also been seen across the haircare brands spiking interest, with science and ingredients sitting at the forefront. Hair fall, thinning hair and scalp health are key concerns, with Minimalist and South Korean brand Aromatica showing up as trending haircare brands. Iso Beauty highlights interest in haircare solutions that deliver salon-quality results at home, while &Honey underscores the popularity of Japanese hair care brands with formulations inspired by honey-based ingredients catering to consumers seeking hydration, shine, and frizz control. Meanwhile, Wow Skin Science reflects continued demand for plant-based haircare products.

On TikTok, #BadNailsCheck has users showing manicure disasters, sharing nail art that turned out completely different from the reference photo. In contrast, #DamagedHairSolutions signals users on a “healthy hair journey”, sharing tips, routines, and product recommendations for repairing damaged hair. #DIYBlush reflects the growing appeal of personalized beauty, with creators customizing blush shades. #MotherOfTheBrideMakeup highlights demand for elegant, age-inclusive makeup inspiration for weddings and other special occasions. Meanwhile, technicians and creators are sharing techniques, product recommendations, and behind-the-scenes glimpses of their daily work with #LashArtistOfTikTok.

Industry observers note that in the wellness space, there’s a growing interest in supplements and solutions that support long-term health, targeted nutrition, and proactive selfcare. Dopamine patches align with demand for wearable wellness solutions aimed at supporting focus, motivation, mood, and cognitive performance. The rise of menopause support supplements highlights interest in formulations that help manage hormonal changes, with consumers seeking products that address symptoms such as hot flashes, mood fluctuations, sleep quality, and overall wellbeing.

Recent findings suggest that meanwhile, kimchi supplements mirror continued focus on gut health, as more consumers look for probiotic-rich alternatives inspired by fermented foods to support digestion and microbiome balance. Vitamin B5 supplements lean into essential nutrients that aid the breakdown of carbohydrates, fats, and proteins, while supporting skin and heart health. Finally, longevity supplements satisfy a growing focus on healthy aging, with consumers seeking science-backed ingredients and formulations that support cellular health and vitality as part of a preventive approach to wellness.

Industry observers note that when it comes to wellness brands, those spanning targeted delivery formats, science-backed nutrition, and performance-focused solutions are performing the best. Gentle Patch reflects demand for convenient, wearable wellness solutions, while Bioschwartz and Webber Naturals represent continued interest in supplement brands that offer vitamins, minerals, probiotics, and herbal formulations for everyday health. Swolverine signals growing demand for performance nutrition that supports strength and recovery, while Zhou Nutrition reflects interest in holistic supplements that promote energy, immune health, sleep, and healthy aging.

Recent findings suggest that on TikTok, the #SummerGlowMakeup and #BeautyFavs hashtags reflect growing interest in curated beauty routines and product discovery, with consumers seeking seasonal makeup inspiration alongside trusted product recommendations. #GeodeNails lean into a demand for artistic, statement-making nail designs that emphasize creativity and self-expression. #DIYMicroLocsJourney adopts a personal storytelling format, as consumers document their hair journeys, while learning protective hair styling techniques. Meanwhile, #DollarTreeSkincareHaul spotlights affordable skincare products, as consumers explore budget-friendly options that fit into their selfcare routines.

In the bodycare category, there’s growing interest in products that combine targeted treatments, ingredient-focused formulations, and at-home wellness solutions. The rise in searches for cellulite oil suggests that consumers are seeking botanical oil blends and firming formulations designed for massaging into the skin as part of anti-cellulite routines. Grape soap highlights demand for playful, fruit-inspired products that combine functionality with novelty and aesthetic appeal. Meanwhile, the popularity of AHA body lotions signals continued interest in ingredient-led skincare, with consumers seeking exfoliating body creams that improve skin texture and smoothness. Epsom salt lotion and red light therapy panels reflect the growing adoption of at-home recovery and wellness routines, as consumers seek products and devices that support muscle comfort, recovery, skin rejuvenation, and temporary pain relief.

In a recent development, science-backed brands with plant-based ingredients and luxury positionings are soaring. Hada Labo, a Japanese brand, and QV Skincare reflect continued demand for gentle, hydration-focused products that support healthy skin through barrier-supportive formulations. Just Nutritive signals a consumer preference for handcrafted, botanical-based products that emphasize naturally derived ingredients, while Nordic Goddess points to the growing intersection of wellness and bodycare, as more consumers seek topical solutions that incorporate THC and CBD for targeted relief. Meanwhile, La Mer underscores demand for premium bodycare, combining intensive hydration with a luxurious, sensorial experience.

Industry observers note that over on TikTok, #CheetahHair, #HaircutTutorials, and #HairFoils are all trending, reflecting a broader shift toward more experimental and technique-driven approaches to hair styling. #CheetahHair highlights bold, pattern-led hair looks that emphasize self-expression and visual impact, #HaircutTutorials points to the growing demand for accessible, step-by-step education from hair stylists, while #HairFoils underscores continued interest in professional coloring techniques. In addition, #PlaitsBraids highlights the appeal of finished braided styles, with content featuring both at-home and salon-created results for men and women. Meanwhile, #CoconutOilForSkin signals an ongoing interest in multi-purpose ingredients used across selfcare routines. Together, these trends reflect a move toward both skill-based hair experimentation and ingredient-driven selfcare practices.

Recent findings suggest that luxury fragrances are becoming more than a special occasion spritz. Consumers are investing in scents that have wide appeal, from sport fragrances for energy, freshness, and an active lifestyle, to sweet smells that have a touch of nostalgia.

Tomato perfume underscores the rise of unconventional fragrance notes, reflecting curiosity around earthy and garden-fresh scent experiences that stand apart from traditional or gourmand offerings. Meanwhile, perfume-making kits are becoming increasingly popular, as rising interest in personalization and creativity push consumers to explore DIY fragrance creation and craft scents tailored to their individual preferences.

Riiffs and Assaf, both Arabian fragrance houses, reflect growing consumer demand for accessible fragrances with strong, long-lasting effects and scent profiles that blend Middle Eastern perfumery traditions with modern styles. Pure Instinct and Rahasya signal interest in fragrances that feel more personal and body-driven, where consumers are drawn to scents designed to interact with individual chemistry and enhance perceived personal appeal. Lore reflects demand for more experiential and concept-led fragrances, as consumers increasingly seek scents that go beyond smell to evoke places, moods, and narratives. Meanwhile, Miu Miu highlights the enduring influence of fashion houses within the fragrance category, as consumers continue to seek scents that blend luxury, creativity, and modern self-expression.

Recent findings suggest that #RedDyedHair, #LashDye, and #SelfTannerHack all reflect a broader shift toward at-home beauty experimentation through DIY techniques. #RedDyedHair highlights bold self-applied color changes as a form of personal expression and transformation. #LashDye reflects interest in low-maintenance beauty routines, where customers tint lashes for longer-lasting definition, and #SelfTannerHack shows how shared tips are used to achieve more controlled, even tanning results. Then, #NosePatches and #NeckSkincareRoutine point to growing demand for targeted skincare solutions, with the former focusing on pore care and blackheads for a quick, temporary smoothing effect, while the latter underscores increasing awareness of often-neglected areas that require attention beyond the face. Together, these trends reflect a move into DIY-driven beauty and targeted treatment routines.

When it comes to nails, consumers are seeking designs that blend self-expression, practicality, and care. BB cream nails reflect demand for natural-looking, low-maintenance manicures, while comic nails highlight a desire for creative and expressive nail art. Matcha nails point to the growing traction of soft green tones, influenced by the cult popularity of the beverage, while solid gel nail glue indicates interest in durable, mess-free nail application, as consumers increasingly value long-lasting performance. Crystal nail files reflect a growing awareness of nail health, with consumers seeking gentler tools that help maintain strong, smooth nails and minimize damage.

It has been revealed that the rise of The Gelbottle, Nail Reformation, Kleo Kolor, and Curvlife each proves growing demand for long-lasting nail solutions that deliver salon-quality results. The Gelbottle reflects interest in professional-grade systems that strengthen and enhance natural nails, while Nail Reformation and Kleo Kolor point to the popularity of reusable press-ons and durable at-home manicure options. Curvlife emphasizes ease of application through reusable soft gel press-ons and adhesive solutions that don’t require UV light. Meanwhile, Hermès underscores the premiumization of the nail category, with consumers seeking luxury nail products and tools featuring shades inspired by Hermès’s design heritage and silk draping — finished with a high-gloss, satin sheen in a single coat.

On TikTok, #CyberPunkNails reflects interest in futuristic nail art that combines punk influences, neon accents, metallic finishes, and bold 3D details. #SkinTintStick highlights demand for hybrid complexion products that offer light coverage with skincare benefits in a portable format. #TCAPeel and #MicrobiomeSkincare signal growing consumer interest in understanding the mechanisms behind skin behavior, from chemical exfoliation and skin renewal to the role of the microbiome in barrier health. In the case of #TCAPeel, viral social media content often emphasizes the risks of extreme at-home use. #HairLossJourney extends this same behavior pattern into haircare, where individuals actively seek to understand the causes of hair loss, sharing progress and seeking support and solutions. Together, these trends reflect a shift toward beauty that combines experimentation, care, and awareness of underlying skin and hair health.

In a recent development, makeup products and techniques that deliver precision, convenience, and natural-looking results are soaring. Contour stain reflects demand for long-wearing, transfer-resistant sculpting products that provide definition with minimal maintenance throughout the day. Meanwhile, cool-toned blush and cool-toned contour underscore consumers’ increasing focus on shade accuracy. At the same time, ghost and pre-glued lashes highlight demand for effortless lash enhancement, combining natural-looking results with faster and easier application methods. Together, these trends suggest that makeup is evolving toward personalized routines that prioritize subtle enhancement, ease of use, and products tailored to individual features and preferences.

It has been revealed that across makeup brands, the rise of Elroel and Purito highlights the continued influence of K-beauty. Elroel reflects growing demand for adaptive complexion products that simplify shade matching, while purito emphasizes lightweight coverage and minimal formulations to avoid skin sensitivities. Dermatologist-founded Rodan and Fields further reinforces interest in hybrid complexion products that combine cosmetic performance with skincare benefits. Meanwhile, the popularity of Brow Daddy highlights consumers’ focus on expertly defined brows and professional-grade beauty solutions offering precision and long-lasting results. KJH.Brand, launched by makeup artist Katie Jane Hughes, underscores the appeal of creative, multi-use makeup that encourages self-expression and flexible application across the eyes, lips, and cheeks.

In a recent development, as more consumers focus on maintaining hair health and reducing damage, #BedtimeHaircare is trending on TikTok and reflects growing interest in overnight prevention treatments. #CollagenFilm highlights K-beauty innovation in the form of dissolvable collagen films, designed for topical application to deliver instant hydration and a smoother, firmer appearance. #BrowFreeze, meanwhile, reflects continued interest in lifted, feathered brow styling that creates a laminated look. #613AmazonWig signals demand for affordable, pre-lightened platinum blonde wigs that enable bold color experimentation without chemical processing, while #GluelessClosureInstall reflects a broader shift in wig culture toward accessible, low-damage styling, where consumers seek dramatic transformations that are easy to apply, comfortable to wear, and avoid the long-term commitment or potential damage associated with traditional installation methods. Together, these trends reflect a move to beauty routines that balance care and transformation, combining preventative habits with low-damage styling and skin-focused innovation.

It has been revealed that consumers are on the hunt for science-led skincare innovations. Interest in silicone scar sticks reflects demand for effective scar products that support skin recovery and improve the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, while simplifying daily treatment routines. Rising interest in needle patches highlights demand for advanced delivery technologies, which enable active ingredients to be delivered directly for enhanced efficacy and targeted results. PDRN creams and serums tap into regenerative ingredients, as consumers seek formulas associated with skin repair, recovery, and renewal. Meanwhile, growth in matte lip balms highlights a desire for hybrid lip products that bridge skincare and makeup, delivering hydration while providing both a tint and a matte finish.

Recent findings suggest that among trending skincare brands, Elm Biosciences underscores the rise in science-backed, clinically developed skincare, with a lab-to-patient approach focused on supporting long-term skin health and healthy aging. Wow Skin Science reflects demand for nature-inspired skincare, offering plant-powered formulations free from harsh chemicals. Sincerely Yours highlights the rise of dermatologist-developed skincare tailored to younger consumers, with a focus on barrier support and the unique needs of teenage skin. Isispharma represents the continued strength of dermocosmetic skincare, providing targeted solutions for concerns such as hyperpigmentation, rosacea, and acne through dermatologist-recommended formulations. Sunplay signals growing emphasis on daily sun protection, leveraging advanced Japanese skincare technology to deliver high-performance UV defense.

In a recent development, on TikTok, #FireHair reflects growing interest in bold, high-impact hair color trends, as more consumers embrace expressive styles. #DyedLocsOnWomen highlights demand for dyed locs as a form of color expression across textured and protective hairstyles. #ShimmerLips leans into the continued interest in glossy, light-reflecting lip finishes, while #WrinkleTreatments underscores rising focus on preventive and corrective skincare solutions, as consumers seek ways to address aging. #HDFrontalWigs showcases high-definition lace frontal wigs, with content centered on installations and styling.

Recent findings suggest that in the haircare space, consumers are searching for products that combine active ingredients, scalp support, and at-home technology. Amino acid shampoos and Capixyl-based formulas reflect a demand for ingredient-led repair and solutions that strengthen hair, while addressing thinning and scalp health. Batana oil shampoos highlight an ongoing interest in nourishing botanical ingredients for hydration and scalpcare, while blonde hair masks emphasize maintenance of tone and softness in color-treated locks. At the same time, red light therapy hats signal the growing adoption of tech-enabled tools for scalp stimulation and hair growth.

Recent findings suggest that hairburst reflects a growing demand for haircare solutions that support stronger, longer hair and address thinning and breakage. KilgourMD represents a dermatologist-founded, science-backed approach to scalp health, offering a targeted system designed to treat hair thinning through plant-based prevention and care. Tgideas highlights interest in rosemary-based botanical haircare aimed at supporting growth, reducing breakage, and improving scalp health. Dr. Groot reflects the strength of Korean dermatological haircare that zeroes in on scalp balance and hair loss prevention through ingredients such as niacinamide, prebiotics, and probiotics. Trybello signals demand for haircare solutions designed to reduce hair loss and promote thicker, fuller-looking hair.

On TikTok, #HeatlessStyling reflects rising interest in low-damage hair routines, as consumers seek ways to achieve results without heat tools. #FastHairstyles highlights demand for quick, efficient styling solutions that slot into busy lifestyles while still delivering polished looks. #FaceGlitter signals continued engagement with expressive makeup, focused on bold, playful self-expression. #MonsterHighNails points to the rise of bold, character-inspired nail designs that emphasize individuality and playful aesthetics, especially among Gen Alpha consumers. #NailArtBrush points to the importance of precision tools in nail design, supporting detailed artwork and professional techniques, alongside guidance from nail techs on choosing the best brushes and how to use them effectively.

It has been revealed that consumers are increasingly drawn to wellness formats that blend supplementation, wearables, and at-home recovery tools into everyday routines. Pheromone gummies reflect growing interest in products that support confidence with a holistic appeal, while dopamine patches align with demand for wearable solutions aimed at focus, motivation, and cognitive performance. GLP-1 and NAD+ patches support metabolism, energy, and cellular function, and multi-collagen supplements continue to gain traction for beauty and structural benefits such as skin, hair, and joint health. Alongside these, percussive massage devices highlight the rise of accessible recovery technologies designed to reduce muscle tension and support circulation after exercise. Together, these trends reflect a shift toward personalized wellness routines using multiple formats that prioritize convenience and seamless integration into everyday life.

In a recent development, javvy Coffee reflects growing demand for functional beverages that integrate wellness benefits such as supporting energy. Myvitamins focuses on simple, accessible nutrition through a wide range of vitamins and supplements that support general health and daily wellbeing. Esther Formula is a South Korean supplement brand known for its glutathione direct films and reflects the rising demand of K-wellness along with beauty-from-within nutrition, where consumers prioritize skin health and radiance through targeted supplementation, along with interest in innovative delivery formats. Swolverine represents performance-focused supplementation designed to support strength, endurance, and recovery through clinically dosed products. Jacob reflects demand for high-protein functional foods made from simple, real ingredients.

In a recent development, #DIYMakeupHacks highlights growing interest in at-home beauty experimentation and resourceful routines, as consumers share and test creative ways to achieve makeup results. #DIYBlush reflects personalization in beauty, with users exploring custom or handmade blush products to tailor color and finish. #SunscreenPowder points to demand for convenience and reapplication-friendly sun protection formats that support on-the-go skincare routines. #NailAcrylic signals focus on durability and design in nailcare, as users compare acrylic applications for strength, longevity, and aesthetic results. #MicroLocInstall reflects interest in protective hairstyling and long-term hair maintenance, particularly around the installation and upkeep of microlocs. Sources indicate that in bodycare, current search trends reveal a strong focus on targeted skin benefits and functional treatment-based products. Epsom salt lotions reflect an interest in convenient options for muscle relief and recovery. Grape soap highlights playful, fruit-inspired formats and visually appealing hand soaps designed to resemble grapes, pointing to a rise in products combining functionality with novelty and aesthetic appeal. Kojic acid lotions are part of a continued attention to skin brightening and evening tone. Meanwhile, the growth of glass foot files reflects a preference for reusable at-home tools that effectively smooth and exfoliate.

As for brands, Papatui reflects a growing interest in the men’s bodycare space, which combines approachable grooming routines with skin-focused formulations, as well as strong demand for its tattoo care line in collaboration with Dwayne Johnson. Luv Scrub, meanwhile, signals a rising demand for authentic African mesh body exfoliators, designed to cleanse and smooth the skin, inspired by traditional West African bath rituals. GoPure Beauty is a results-driven bodycare brand centered on accessible firming and brightening solutions, while QV Skincare offers sensitive-skin solutions rooted in dermatologist-backed, barrier-supportive formulations designed for everyday use. Cyklar highlights the rise of fragrance-forward bodycare that merges fine fragrance inspiration with sustainable practices and sensorial personal care experiences.

This week, #WashAndSet reflects a continued interest in professional salon services on TikTok, where hair is washed, conditioned, and set on rollers before drying to create smooth, polished, and long-lasting results. #CherryAngioma signals the growing consumer attention toward skin education and concerns, as consumers seek information around specific skin conditions. The #LashExpert hashtag points to demand for specialized beauty professionals who showcase precision techniques and lash transformations, while #MakeupWithSPF captures the rising interest in hybrid beauty products that combine cosmetic performance with everyday sun protection. #StylistHair signals engagement with hairstylist-driven content that blends transformations and recommendations from experts. These trends reveal that beauty consumers are increasingly drawn to content centered on expert guidance, visible results, and multifunctional routines.

There’s a growing interest in more personalized and occasion-driven fragrance choices. The search for masculine fragrance suggests that scent is increasingly functioning as an identity marker for male consumers, driving greater interest in variety and personalization. Indie perfume highlights a shift toward niche artistry and unique scents. Birthday cake perfume points to playful, gourmand fragrances inspired by dessert-like notes. Bridal perfume underscores the role of scent in key life moments, with consumers seeking signature fragrances for special occasions. Meanwhile, clean fresh perfume indicates that consumers continue to seek out fresh, lighter options as a counterpoint to richer, gourmand scents.

Recent findings suggest that arabiyat Prestige and Assaf, both Arabian fragrance houses, reflect a growing interest in heritage-led scents defined by richness, high concentration, and long-lasting wear. YCZ signals the rise of social media-driven accessibility, where viral scents and dupes offer more affordable alternatives to traditional designer perfumes. Tenth Muse reflects interest in solid perfumes that prioritize portability, skin sensitivity, and easy application. Sorce underscores interest in bold, imaginative fragrances that lean into gourmand and whimsical scent profiles inspired by fantasy and more playful notes.

Industry observers note that on TikTok, #PrismHair reflects an interest in bold, color-driven hair looks that emphasize a multi-tonal, iridescent finish. #NaturalNailJourney highlights a shift toward nail health and growth, as consumers document and prioritize stronger, natural nails. #KeratinOil points to demand for ingredient-led care for the scalp and beard, focusing on smoothing, repairing, and enhancing shine. #BridalMakeupArtists captures both final results and day-to-day content, offering a behind-the-scenes look at the work and routines of bridal artists. #MillennialSkincare signals continued engagement from this generation, as they share routines that balance efficacy, prevention, and maintenance in skincare. Together, these trends show that consumers are balancing aesthetic expression with long-term care and behind-the-scenes visibility across beauty content.

According to recent reports, nail trends are getting personal, with consumers adding letters to their nails or intricate patterns like gingham. The rise of nail art tools signal growing interest in the techniques behind these looks, as consumers aim to create more complex designs. Diamond Cosmetics highlights demand for affordable, everyday tools, making essential nail utensils widely accessible. Nail Reformation reflects interest in high-quality, reusable press-on nails that offer a salon-level, damage-free alternative to shellac. The Gel Bottle has released variations of pigments, foils, and brushes that enable the creation of more intricate nail art. Curvlife emphasizes ease of application through reusable soft gel press-ons and adhesive solutions that don’t require UV light, while Onyx Professional, with products like Hard As Hoof, points to a preference for treatment-focused nailcare that strengthens and repairs weak or brittle nails.

According to recent reports, on beauty TikTok, #OrangeCandle reflects interest in DIY hacks that show how to make a candle from an orange using simple household items, creating a citrusy aroma. #BlackGirlWashDay highlights routine-focused care tailored to textured hair, emphasizing maintenance and health. #PermRodSetNaturalHair points to technique-driven styling for defined, heat-free curls. #WingedLinerTutorial underscores demand for step-by-step guidance in achieving precise makeup looks, while #LongHairHack signals interest in tips and shortcuts for managing and styling long hair. Together, these hashtags show that consumers are seeking practical, how-to guidance across routines, techniques, and hacks in beauty content.

Current search data reveals a growing interest in functional, personalized makeup. Gluten-free lipstick highlights rising awareness of ingredient sensitivities, while medium-coverage concealer points to a preference for balanced, skin-like finishes. Together, these trends indicate that makeup is evolving toward customized, results-driven routines that combine performance, personalization, and ingredient-conscious choices.

The rise of Tilt Beauty reflects a shift toward accessible, inclusive design, showing that consumers value products tailored to different abilities and needs. On TikTok, the rise of #LocDetoxing reflects a demand for deep-cleansing routines that support scalp and hair health, particularly among protective styles. #HairPlop highlights an interest in techniques that enhance natural texture, especially for defining curls with minimal effort. #TakingDownBraids points to maintenance-focused content, as consumers navigate the full lifecycle of protective styles. #SunscreenApplication underscores growing attention to proper usage and technique in daily skincare routines, while #AirbrushSprayTan focuses on in-process guidance, from what to wear to how to ensure even results. In skincare, current search data reveals a rising focus on advanced, treatment-led products. Interest in scar sticks reflects demand for targeted solutions that simplify care for specific concerns. Industry observers note that ELM Biosciences underscores the growing interest in science-backed, clinically developed skincare, with a “lab-to-patient” approach supporting long-term skin health and the concept of aging well. Current search data reveals a haircare consumer increasingly focused on targeted, treatment-led products. Industry observers note that playa Beauty reflects interest in California-inspired products promising effortless “beach hair”, supporting minimalist routines while enhancing natural waves and movement. It has been revealed that on TikTok, #DitchedTheDye reflects a shift among older women embracing their natural hair color and moving away from maintenance-heavy routines. #ILoveCurlyHair highlights a growing appreciation for natural texture, as consumers celebrate and care for their curls. #PromMakeupInspo points to planning and inspiration for key events, with owners seeking polished, occasion-ready looks. #CubanTwistHair underscores interest in protective styling and cultural hair practices, while #HairFoam signals demand for styling products that enhance texture and hold. Recent findings suggest that consumers are increasingly seeking convenient, easy-to-use formats and wearable solutions for functional wellness, with patches offering targeted support for mood, metabolism and cellular health. #LashGlues highlights interest in product performance and comparison between brands, as consumers test glues for reliable, long-lasting lash applications. #MakeupSamples reflects budget-conscious discovery, with shoppers exploring trial sizes and low-commitment ways to test products. #HairTrial points to planning and preparation, as users test styles ahead of key moments. According to recent reports, there’s an increasing focus on functional, treatment-led bodycare products that deliver targeted results. Interest in epsom salt lotions reflects a demand for convenient, topical solutions that soothe sore muscles and support recovery. It has been revealed that #CheapBeauty is trending on TikTok, showing that consumers are exploring budget-conscious cosmetic options and highlighting an interest in affordable products. #SkincareComedy reflects engagement with humorous, relatable beauty moments, where audiences enjoy playful takes on everyday experiences. #HairExtensionInstallation points to professional, technique-focused content, as viewers watch skilled stylists demonstrate expert application and installation. There’s a craving for gourmand fragrances taking place, as rich, edible-inspired scents capture consumer attention. Searches for masculine fragrances suggest that scent is functioning as an identity marker for male consumers, driving greater interest in variety and personalization. Tomato perfume reflects curiosity around hyper-specific, ingredient-led scents that invite consumers to reimagine familiar smells in a latest context. Solid fragrances, meanwhile, point to demand for portable alternatives to spray bottles, where fragrance layering can extend beyond the home. Finally, clean, fresh perfumes reveal how consumers are seeking out fresh, lighter options as a counterpoint to rich, gourmand notes.

The popularity of Middle Eastern houses like Arabiyat Prestige, Gulf Orchid, and Assaf highlights a consumer shift toward heritage-rich fragrances known for their high-concentration and long-lasting power. Narcotica underscores the appeal of the niche Italian market, where the focus is on “addictive”, high-concentration gourmands that blend bold sweetness with luxurious, long-lasting ingredients.

#TrippyNails are trending, showing that consumers are drawn to surreal, psychedelic nail aesthetics that use distorted patterns and holographic finishes to create eye-catching results. #EasterMakeup reflects a fascination with seasonal, pastel-driven makeup, highlighting how soft color palettes and whimsical details capture attention during spring celebrations. #MakeupCleansingBalm points to growing interest in high-performance cleansers that remove heavy makeup without drying out the skin or leaving it feeling stripped. Meanwhile, #GRWMDate and #HairGoneWrong capture unfiltered, relatable beauty experiences. The former centers on personal storytelling and dating life while getting ready, and the latter highlights the reality of styling mishaps, illustrating how beauty audiences value both the social side of getting ready and the more candid moments that happen along the way.

It has been revealed that what’s drawing consumers in? According to data, its playful and creative nail expressions. There’s increased interest in stained glass and matcha nails, as consumers seek visually striking, color-rich designs that combine artistry with trend-driven aesthetics. Meanwhile, polka dot nails highlight a preference for playful patterns that add personality to everyday manicures. The rise of nail art pens signals a move toward precision and customization. Finally, solid gel nail glue indicates attention to durable, reliable application, showing that consumers value long-lasting performance alongside unique nail looks.

Sources indicate that in terms of brands, the rise of Heyhae reflects a shift toward convenient, at-home nail solutions, as more consumers value semi-cured gel strips, which can be applied under natural sunlight for quick, non-toxic manicures. Diamond Cosmetics highlights the demand for affordable, everyday nail tools, making professional-grade manicures accessible to a wide audience. Nail Reformation demonstrates interest in high-quality, reusable press-on nails, offering a salon-level, damage-free experience at home. Meanwhile, Sunuv and IBD Beauty underscore the appeal of salon-level equipment and innovations — from UV and LED lamps to builder gel.

This week on TikTok, #RobeCurls are trending, as more consumers are drawn to heatless styling techniques that simplify hair routines while delivering defined, natural-looking results. #IceCreamNails reflects a fascination with playful, dessert-inspired nail aesthetics, which underscore how novelty textures and creative color palettes capture attention across nail content. The #LipOilGloss hashtag spotlights lip products that combine shine, nourishment, and a lightweight feel in everyday routines.
